GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Please
   C. Good night
   D. Thank you

2. When practising Active Listening Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening Interactive speaking.

3. When practising Listening for information, Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Oral Expression.

4. When practising Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Extensive Reading.

5. When practising Active Listening, Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Interactive speaking.

6. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Wasser
   C. Schule
   D. Buch

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for fluency, Scanning for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Skimming for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Scanning for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
